inspection_snapshot.scope: current repository code, tests, contracts, current-session MCP inventory and exact prior Drama development evidence

negative_runtime_search.meaning: No typed Drama Product Runtime or DRAMA-MEDIA adjudicator exists; this does not negate the separately owned Agent/HUMAN Development path.

authority_boundary.development_execution_owner: current primary Agent following accepted Drama Spec and repository gates
authority_boundary.subjective_verdict_owner: current user or a HUMAN designee explicitly authorized before playback
authority_boundary.provider_lifecycle_owner: VideoGenerationService with ProductionStateCommitter as sole durable writer
authority_boundary.raw_analysis_authority: project-local video-analysis MCP, advisory raw evidence only
authority_boundary.reason: Milestone 6 is a bounded Development empirical lane; Milestone 7 separately productizes exact pairwise media evidence only after dual-domain closure. Requiring the M7 seam before M6-D would invert the accepted execution order.
authority_boundary.forbidden_promotion: This path cannot write or imply Manifest/Registry activation, ReviewReceipt, P6, Final Acceptance, publication or release.

exact_run_evidence_paths.identity_rule: Every record must bind its own schema/version, exact accepted package/profile/rubric/fixture/baseline identities, unique attempt identity, target media size/SHA/stream facts, authority/tool identities, timestamps and all input-record SHA-256 values. Records are immutable and must be created exclusively: a new Shot or assembly SHA requires a new unique attempt-qualified path or a new run_id, and existing evidence must never be overwritten. A referenced path without a matching SHA is NOT_EVALUATED.

exact_preflight_record_requirements: canonical Drama Shot revision to runtime Shot ID/revision/content-hash projection
Project/Registry selected revisions and content hashes
VideoPlanningRequest, plan, generation requirement, readiness result and verified projection hashes
per-Shot SourceAudioPolicy resolved against the selected Provider output capability
output destination, exact one-attempt identity, local or paid authorization/gate identity and unknown-outcome stop
OPEN_VIDEO_JUDGE_RETRIES=0 or equivalent proof that no internal un-Gated extra take is possible
execution_layers.stop_rule: Any missing, stale, mismatched or BLOCKED input stops before preview, permit, upload or submit. The accepted package does not auto-load into Product Runtime; the preflight record must explicitly bind the projection without inventing Story/Scene/Character/Shot facts.

Known failure and unknown outcome are durably distinct. Unknown outcome, incomplete durable phase, identity drift or fetch/probe mismatch stops without blind retry, permit remint or next Shot submit. No candidate activation occurs in this Development lane.

sequence: Generate exactly one Shot once through the canonical Provider lifecycle.
Fix exact MP4 path, size, SHA-256 and measured stream identity.
Explicitly call project-local video-analysis on the exact path; at minimum bind probe and sampled visual evidence, plus transcription/audio/scene/lip-sync evidence whenever required.
Record raw MCP output references and tool identities in shot_raw_analysis.
Map raw evidence to independent technical findings in shot_agent_gate; MCP output does not self-verdict Drama requirements.
Present the exact full Shot at 1.0x with full audio to the authorized HUMAN and record every applicable DRAMA-MEDIA-SHOT finding with rationale and playback attestation.
Permit the next submit only when all technical findings and all required HUMAN findings are PASS.
execution_layers.stop_rule: FAIL, NOT_EVALUATED, stale/missing evidence, identity mismatch or incomplete HUMAN playback sets next_shot_submit_allowed=false. A later repair is a new exact attempt and cannot be automatically chained.

sequence: After target Shot per-Shot PASS, bind complete source and target MP4 paths, sizes, SHAs and stream identities.
Record numeric source terminal and target opening review-window boundaries and the exact extraction/playback method without changing either source file.
Play source terminal context continuously into target opening context at 1.0x with full audio.
Record HUMAN authority, authorization source/timestamp, playback attestation and every applicable DRAMA-MEDIA-PAIR finding.
Only pairwise all-required PASS permits the submit after the target Shot or whole-scene assembly after the final pair.
execution_layers.current_boundary: GeneratedShotContinuityEvidence currently binds source_shot_id and target artifact SHA but not complete source MP4 SHA or reviewed source/target windows. Milestone 7 owns future Product Runtime productization; the M6-D record is content-addressed Development evidence and cannot become a P6 receipt.
execution_layers.stop_rule: Any required pairwise FAIL/NOT_EVALUATED, source/target SHA drift, window mismatch, missing full-audio playback or unauthorized reviewer stops M6-D before another submit or assembly.

sequence: Assemble only per-Shot and adjacent-pair PASS media in sealed Shot order.
Record ordered component paths/sizes/SHAs, exact cut/transition semantics, concat/compositor/tool identity, audio handling and output assembly path/size/SHA/stream identity.
Bind the accepted baseline payload and acceptance SHAs plus every selected baseline dimension/floor.
Play the exact assembled scene once, uninterrupted, at 1.0x with full audio and no scrubbing during the primary verdict.
Record HUMAN authority, authorization source/timestamp, playback attestation, all DRAMA-MEDIA-SCENE findings and each baseline-dimension verdict.
execution_layers.current_boundary: The exact assembly is a bounded M6-D Development review artifact. It does not claim canonical P4 ingestion of generated Provider audio, Production render activation, Drama Gate 2, P6 or Final Acceptance. Any post-assembly edit, re-encode, retime, transition or audio replacement creates a new SHA and requires fresh whole-scene evidence.
execution_layers.stop_rule: Any required whole-scene or baseline FAIL/NOT_EVALUATED, component mismatch, undeclared transition, interrupted/non-1.0x/non-full-audio playback or identity drift keeps M6-D not passed.

rules: Provider outcome unknown is a durable STOP and never authorizes blind retry or permit remint.
New Shot media SHA invalidates that Shot's per-Shot evidence, both adjacent pair records and whole-scene evidence.
New assembly SHA invalidates the whole-scene and baseline verdicts even when component Shot SHAs are unchanged.
Authoring package/profile/rubric/fixture/baseline/HUMAN authority identity drift invalidates every evidence record in its declared coverage.
Drama, Commercial, Base AI Comic, technical and historical verdicts never fill one another's findings.
Shared Core identity change requires both domain lanes to revalidate applicable shared findings; it does not rewrite preserved historical observations.

shot_sequence_barrier.shot_1_to_shot_2: Shot 1 technical findings PASS and all required Shot 1 HUMAN findings PASS.
shot_sequence_barrier.shot_2_to_shot_3: Shot 2 technical findings PASS, all required Shot 2 HUMAN findings PASS and pair 1->2 all-required HUMAN findings PASS.
shot_sequence_barrier.shot_3_to_assembly: Shot 3 technical findings PASS, all required Shot 3 HUMAN findings PASS and pair 2->3 all-required HUMAN findings PASS.
shot_sequence_barrier.assembly_to_m6_d_verdict: Whole-scene and every applicable baseline dimension receive exact all-required HUMAN PASS with all identities current.

focused_tests.command: python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_shot_readiness_gate.py tests/test_video_generation.py tests/test_mcp_analyze.py -q
focused_tests.meaning: Current generic readiness, lifecycle guards and project-local MCP/hook behavior pass; no Drama Product Runtime is inferred.

aggregate_decision.next_action_if_exactly_accepted: B-D0 may become PASS. M6-D remains a separately authorized empirical slice and must begin with a fresh exact pre-submit record; no Provider, prompt or media action is authorized by this artifact.
